# opnsense_nginx_http_rewrite (Resource)

nginx URL rewrites (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ HTTP(S) ▸ URL Rewriting**, plugin `os-nginx`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_nginx_http_rewrite" "old_blog" {
  description = "old-blog"
  source      = "^/blog/(.*)$"
  destination = "/news/$1"
  flag        = "permanent"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Enter a short description like a name for this redirect. No spaces, tabs or double quotes.
- `destination` (String) You may use replacement strings like $1 for the first match group from the source here. No spaces, tabs or double quotes.
- `source` (String) Enter a regular expression to match the URL.

### Optional

- `flag` (String) Stop rule processing (break) or perform (internal) redirect (last). Return a moved permanently status code (301) or a temporary redirect (302). One of `break`, `last`, `redirect`, `permanent`. Defaults to ``.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx URL rewrite.
